data.input:
spnego_gss_unwrap_aead(OM_uint32 *vh,
		       gss_ctx_id_t yj,
		       gss_buffer_t ch,
		       gss_buffer_t dm,
		       gss_buffer_t io,
		       int *ul,
		       gss_qop_t *fl)
{
	OM_uint32 ret;
	ret = gss_unwrap_aead(vh,
			      yj,
			      ch,
			      dm,
			      io,
			      ul,
			      fl);
	return (ret);
}
